caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown ceramic pitcher with a pronounced spout and a rounded handle attached to the left side. The surface of the pitcher displays a variety of brown and reddish-brown tones, with darker speckles and subtle shadows suggesting texture and form. The number "1796" is inscribed near the upper portion of the body, just below the mouth of the pitcher. The handle curves smoothly from the upper edge to the widest part of the base. The pitcher is set against a light, beige background, which is bordered by a simple, thin rectangular line. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Yolande DeLasser" is written.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
